clue.text: Jumping off the rails, ignoring judge's challenge

indicators.note: something off the rails has gone wild and out of order, so the letters left are scrambled
ignoring something leaves it out, so the judge's letter is dropped from the word before

parts.note: J is the standard abbreviation for judge

explanation.surface: A judge challenges someone whose jumping has gone badly off course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ignoring' drops J from JUMPING to leave UMPING, which 'off the rails' then rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: To impugn a claim is to dispute or call it into question, a formal word for challenging it.

clue.text: Faultless conception of a particular religion?

definitions.meaning: the Roman Catholic doctrine that Mary was conceived free of original sin is named with this word before 'Conception'

explanation.surface: A theological question about a flawless doctrine held by one church.
explanation.definitionFit: Spotless and without any flaw; the word also names the Catholic doctrine of the Immaculate Conception.

clue.text: Minor in court shown how to treat the family dog?

definitions.meaning: in legal usage this French-derived word means small or lesser

definitions.text: how to treat the family dog?
definitions.meaning: read as two words, the instruction is to stroke and fondle the animal

explanation.surface: A child in court is shown the right way to look after a pet.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition splits the answer into PET IT, the way to treat a dog.
explanation.definitionFit: Petit is a legal term for minor or lesser offences, as in petit larceny.

clue.text: Bear dreadful noise

indicators.note: a noise is something heard, so a word for dreadful is taken by its sound

parts.note: grisly means gruesome or dreadful

explanation.surface: A bear makes an awful sound.
explanation.walkthrough: 'noise' says that GRISLY (dreadful) is heard rather than seen, giving a word that sounds the same.
explanation.definitionFit: The grizzly is a large brown bear of North America.

clue.text: A worker ecstatic to be called in? No!

definitions.text: A worker ecstatic to be called in? No!

indicators.note: something called in is brought inside, so the word for ecstatic goes into the middle of the worker

parts.note: a worker is a bee, as in the worker caste of a hive
sent is an old slang word for ecstatic or carried away

explanation.surface: A thrilled employee wonders whether they are being summoned, only to be told no.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue doubles as the definition: a worker who is anything but thrilled to be summoned is the one who stays away.
explanation.definitionFit: An absentee is someone not present, who does not turn up when summoned.

clue.text: Graduate hosts old ambassador for tea

indicators.note: a host takes guests inside, so the graduate's letters surround the others

parts.note: BA is a Bachelor of Arts, a graduate
HE, His Excellency, is the title of an ambassador

explanation.surface: A graduate entertains a retired diplomat over tea.
explanation.definitionFit: Bohea is a black China tea, popular in the eighteenth century.

clue.text: Capital got over being without a ruler

indicators.note: being without here means outside, so the turned capital goes around the other piece
turned over means reversed, so the capital is read backwards

parts.note: Rome is the capital of Italy
per means a, as in so much a week

explanation.surface: A city recovers after having no ruler.
explanation.walkthrough: 'got over' gives EMOR. 'Capital' sounds like the definition of a ruler's seat, but it is only the city.
explanation.definitionFit: An emperor is the sovereign ruler of an empire.

clue.text: Picture of recording — has hundred imported

indicators.note: imported means brought in, so the middle pieces go inside the recording

parts.note: a tape is a recording
owns means has, possesses
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: A recording is said to contain an imported hundred.
explanation.walkthrough: A townscape is a scene, so 'Picture' is the definition rather than a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A townscape is a painting or picture of an urban scene.

clue.text: Deserve long year off

indicators.note: off means removed, so the year's letter is dropped from the longing word

parts.note: to long for something is to yearn

explanation.surface: Someone earns a long year off work.
explanation.definitionFit: To earn something is to merit it through effort, a synonym for deserve.

clue.text: Calm track, number Queen recorded, you included

indicators.note: included means placed inside, so the short pieces go into the track

parts.note: a trail is a track
Q is how a queen is written down in chess notation and on playing cards
U stands for you in text speak

explanation.surface: A calm piece of music with a recorded Queen number that includes you.
explanation.walkthrough: 'included' puts N, Q and U inside TRAIL. The surface hints at the band Queen, but it is just chess notation.
explanation.definitionFit: Tranquil means peaceful and free from disturbance, a close synonym for calm.

clue.text: Woman dominating in right manner, back in game

indicators.note: in places the turned pieces inside the game

parts.note: a match is a game

indicators.note: back means backwards, so the right and the manner are read in reverse

parts.note: an air is a manner or bearing

explanation.surface: A woman takes charge in the proper way during a game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' gives RIAR. The first 'in' is a link word only.
explanation.definitionFit: A matriarch is a woman who heads and rules a family or group.

clue.text: The ability to make an index

definitions.meaning: capacity or capability to do something
in maths an index is the exponent showing how many times a number is multiplied by itself

explanation.surface: A question of what it takes to compile an index.
explanation.definitionFit: Power means capacity to act, and in maths it is an exponent, also called an index.

clue.text: One's right to restrain criminal activity

definitions.text: One's right to restrain criminal activity

parts.words: One's right to restrain criminal activity
parts.note: the right of any member of the public, not just police, to detain someone caught committing a crime

explanation.definitionFit: An ordinary person may legally detain someone seen committing an offence, which is this kind of arrest.

clue.text: Almost totally alert, .mature, and fashionable

parts.note: all means totally, completely

indicators.note: almost means not quite complete, so the last letter of the word for alert is dropped

parts.note: there, as in all there, means mentally alert
to mature is to age

explanation.surface: Someone nearly wide awake, grown up and stylish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'All there' is an idiom for being mentally sharp; 'Almost' trims its last E.
explanation.definitionFit: Something all the rage is very popular and in fashion at the moment.

clue.text: Such ideals frequently intruding on the bounds of liberty?

indicators.note: intruding means pushing in, so one piece goes between the others
bounds are the edges, so only the first and last letters of the word are used

parts.note: oft is a poetic word for often or frequently

explanation.surface: High-minded ideals that keep pushing at the limits of freedom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the bounds of' takes the first and last letters of 'liberty', L and Y, and 'intruding on' puts OFT between them.
explanation.definitionFit: Lofty describes noble, elevated aims, the sort of high ideals the clue mentions.

clue.text: Laugh a lot, or quarrel, when sailor butts in?

indicators.note: butting in means pushing into the middle, so the sailor goes inside the quarrel

parts.note: to fall out is to quarrel
AB, able seaman, is a sailor

explanation.surface: A row turns to laughter when a sailor interrupts.
explanation.walkthrough: AB is the abbreviation for able seaman.
explanation.definitionFit: To fall about is an informal phrase for laughing uncontrollably.

clue.text: Where the deck is prepared for a voyage

definitions.text: Where the deck is prepared for a voyage

parts.words: Where the deck is prepared for a voyage
parts.note: on a sailing ship the deck lies literally below the canvas, and the phrase also means a ship is moving by wind power

explanation.definitionFit: A ship's deck sits literally below its canvas, and the phrase means a vessel is travelling by wind.

clue.text: Failure to put letters in file correctly?

definitions.text: Failure to put letters in file correctly?

parts.words: Failure to put letters in file correctly?
parts.note: the clue sounds like office filing, but it describes a learning difficulty in which letters get muddled when reading and spelling

explanation.definitionFit: This learning difficulty makes it hard to read and order letters correctly in words.

clue.text: Count noisy dogs and put in sneaky report

parts.note: to tell is an old word for to count, as in a bank teller

indicators.note: noisy means heard aloud, so the word for dogs is taken by its sound

parts.note: to dog someone is to follow them, and tails do the same

explanation.surface: A dog owner counts barking hounds and files a sly complaint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'noisy' turns TAILS (dogs, follows) into a word that sounds the same. The definition describes the people: sneaks are those who put in reports.
explanation.definitionFit: Telltales are sneaks who inform on others, putting in reports behind their backs.

clue.text: Still up, stuffing bread in basket

indicators.note: the bread is stuffed into the turned word, so it goes inside
in a down entry up means read from bottom to top, so the word is reversed

parts.note: yet means still, as in not yet done
a roll is a piece of bread

explanation.surface: Bread is still being packed into a basket.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' gives TEY, since this is a down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A shopping trolley is a wheeled basket used in a supermarket.

clue.text: Declare time has come to turn aside

parts.note: to aver is to declare or assert

explanation.surface: Someone announces it is time to look away.
explanation.definitionFit: To avert something is to turn it away or prevent it, as in averting your eyes.

clue.text: Such changes set in in the manner of Irish darling

indicators.note: set in means placed inside, so the rearranged letters go into the other piece

parts.note: a la, from French, means in the manner of

indicators.note: changes signals that the letters of the word beside it are rearranged

explanation.surface: Changes are made in the style of an Irish sweetheart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changes' gives CUSH. A LA is French for in the manner of.
explanation.definitionFit: Acushla is an Irish term of endearment meaning my darling or my heart's pulse.

clue.text: Whereby one ends up with the lion's share, as a rule?

definitions.text: Whereby one ends up with the lion's share, as a rule?

parts.words: Whereby one ends up with the lion's share, as a rule?
parts.note: the principle that the strongest take most, as among wild beasts, where the lion literally takes the biggest share

explanation.definitionFit: This ruthless principle says the strongest win, as when a lion takes the biggest portion of a kill.

clue.text: Charmed to be accepted

explanation.surface: Someone delighted to be welcomed.
explanation.definitionFit: Taken means captivated, as in taken with someone, and also received or accepted.

clue.text: Chief electrician finally sacked for indiscreet remark

indicators.note: the final letter is sacked, that is removed

parts.note: the gaffer is the chief electrician on a film or TV set

explanation.surface: A head electrician is fired for saying something tactless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'finally sacked' removes the last letter, R, from GAFFER.
explanation.definitionFit: A gaffe is a social blunder, especially a tactless or indiscreet comment.

clue.text: River seen in the Broads

indicators.note: seen in signals that the letters can be found inside the following words

explanation.surface: A river spotted in the Norfolk Broads, a region of English waterways.
explanation.walkthrough: The Broads are a network of rivers and lakes in Norfolk, England, which makes the river seem local.
explanation.definitionFit: The Ebro is a major river in northern Spain.

clue.text: Maybe grill, or cook otherwise, with right ingredient

indicators.note: an ingredient goes into a dish, so the right letter is placed inside

parts.note: boiling is another way to cook

explanation.surface: A cooking tip: grill, or cook a different way, with the right ingredient.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ingredient' puts R inside BOIL.
explanation.definitionFit: To broil is to cook under direct heat; grilling is one way of doing it.

clue.text: Recalled if dianthus, perhaps, is round house, next to a red-hot poker

indicators.note: turned round means reversed, so the flower's name is read backwards

parts.note: the pink is a kind of dianthus

indicators.note: recalled means called back, so the little word is read backwards

explanation.surface: A gardener lists flowers: dianthus, a red-hot poker and something near the house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' gives KNIP and 'Recalled' gives FI. A red-hot poker is a garden plant with spikes of red and yellow flowers, not a fireside tool.
explanation.definitionFit: Kniphofia is the botanical name of the red-hot poker, an African garden plant.

clue.text: Likely to lose heart, in excursion in remote area

indicators.note: in places the trimmed word inside the excursion

parts.note: an outing is an excursion or trip

indicators.note: losing the heart leaves only the first and last letters of the word

explanation.surface: A trip to the back of beyond may leave you discouraged.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to lose heart' keeps only the first and last letters of 'Likely', L and Y, which go inside OUTING.
explanation.definitionFit: Outlying describes places situated far from the centre, remote and distant.

clue.text: Changes one neglected, by East European composer

indicators.note: something neglected is left out, so the letter for one is dropped

parts.note: to change is to vary, so changes is varies
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A composer from the east of Europe makes changes after one is overlooked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'neglected' drops I from VARIES to leave VARES.
explanation.definitionFit: Edgard Varese was a French-born composer of experimental twentieth-century music.
